turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Hi, come on in. Can you give me your full name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Asha Bello, March 11th, 1997.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Thanks, Asha. The nurse said you're having some burning.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yeah, since Saturday, so two days. It burns when I pee, and I feel like I have to go every twenty minutes, even when nothing much comes out.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: That sounds miserable. Any pain in your lower belly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Kind of a pressure, right down low. have you seen any blood in your urine no I don't think so it's been orange since yesterday but that's the AZO I took good that you mentioned it how much of the AZO the box says two tablets three times a day so I did that yesterday and once this morning okay any fever or chills no fever pain in your back or your side,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: up here under the ribs? Nausea or vomiting?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any vaginal discharge,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: itching,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: or odor?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When was your last period, and what are you using for birth control?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My period ended about two weeks ago,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: totally normal.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have the copper IUD, I got it last year.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any chance of pregnancy otherwise?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so. Have you had a bladder infection before? Once in college. Maybe three years ago. It cleared up with antibiotics and I've been fine since. My roommate swears by cranberry pills, so I've been drinking cranberry juice too.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Cranberry won't hurt, but it won't cure it. Any allergies to medications?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nuns.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Okay, your temperature is 98 .2, blood pressure 118 over 72, pulse 80. Let me press on your belly. There's mild tenderness right above the pubic bone and tapping on your back any pain.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No that's fine.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: No tenderness over the kidneys. We did a urine dip here in the office. It's positive for white blood cells and positive for nitrites. No blood and no protein. One thing though, the AZO can tint the dip and throw off the colors so I'm also sending your urine for a culture to be sure.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, makes sense.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: So this looks like a simple bladder infection, what we call acute cystitis. I'm going to start you on nitrofurantoin 100 milligrams twice a day for five days. Take it with food, it's easier on the stomach.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, can you send it to the pharmacy on Kessler Road? And can I keep taking the AZO?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I'll send it there. You can keep the AZO, but only for one more day, so two days total. drink plenty of water. The culture takes two to three days. If it shows something the nitro furan toin doesn't cover, we'll call you and switch. Is 555 -0118 the best number?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, that's my cell.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: And if you develop fever, back or side pain,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: or vomiting,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: that could mean the infection is moving up to the kidneys, so call us the same day. If you're not better in two to three days let us know otherwise no follow -up needed great thank you so much you're welcome Aisha feel better
